title: Choose models and parallel briefs for bounded assignments

rubric.text: Uses an available general agent with Luna/low for A; worker or other suitable unpinned role Terra/medium for B and C; worker Sol/medium for D; suitable unpinned role Sol/high for E, Sol/medium for F, and Sol/xhigh for G; explorer for specific discovery H, inspecting its exposed pins before choosing unpinned settings. Does not invent unavailable checker/investigator roles, install definitions, inherit the parent model, or escalate to Astra.
Launches all genuinely independent assignments concurrently within stated capacity; rejects serializing merely for reporting and names actual dependencies if any.

D's dispatch proposal gives worker, gpt-6.2-sol/medium, and fork_turns=none with explicitly supplied unpinned settings. Its self-contained brief names the supplied checkout and revision, ui/banner.ts ownership, the false and true canRetry behaviors and npm test -- banner, tells the worker to preserve others' edits, reserves remote writes to root, and forbids unauthorized further delegation.
